critical_bugs.title: Discrepancy in Absent-Student Percentage: Dashboard Analytics vs Report Card
critical_bugs.description: report_cards.py includes absent exam papers in the total_max denominator (producing e.g. 31.0%), but stats.py exam_percentages() omits absent papers from the denominator (producing e.g. 37.2%). Principals and teachers see conflicting percentages between executive analytics and printed student report cards.
critical_bugs.root_cause: stats.exam_percentages() was not updated when report_cards.py was remediated for Issue 6.
critical_bugs.impact: Conflicting metrics presented to school leadership, parents, and regulatory inspectors. Erodes administrative trust.
critical_bugs.remediation: Align stats.py exam_percentages() calculation to count scheduled max marks for absent papers in total_max.

critical_bugs.title: Transfer Certificate (TC) Issued Without Mandatory Fee Dues Gate
critical_bugs.description: A student with outstanding unpaid fee invoices can be issued a formal Transfer Certificate (TC) without a hard block. In real schools, issuing a TC permanently discharges a student, forfeiting the school's legal leverage to collect unpaid arrears.
critical_bugs.root_cause: certificates.py checks student enrollment but does not query fee_invoices balance > 0 to enforce a hard lockout.
critical_bugs.impact: Financial loss for the school; students withdraw without settling pending term dues.
critical_bugs.remediation: Add strict check in certificates.py: if student has unsettled fee invoices (balance > 0), raise HTTP 422 'Cannot issue TC: Pending fee dues of Rs. X must be cleared first' unless overridden by Admin.

missing_features.impact: Schools frequently receive fee refund requests if parent withdraws before session commencement. Currently zero refund API/UI exists in admissions.
Sibling records are captured in dossier, but fee concessions must be applied manually in Fee Setup rather than automatically.
CBSE secondary science classes require 2 consecutive periods (e.g. Physics practicals). Current system models each slot as 1 discrete period.

missing_features.feature: Classroom Room Capacity & Special Facility Validation
missing_features.impact: Slots assign arbitrary room strings; system does not validate room capacity against section strength (e.g. assigning 45 students to a 30-seat room).

missing_features.feature: Partial Fee Refund & Credit Note Management
missing_features.impact: When a student leaves or overpays, schools require a formal credit note or refund receipt with cheque/transaction reference. ERP only records collections.

missing_features.feature: Cheque Dishonour / Bounce Handling & Penalty Ledger
missing_features.impact: Indian schools collect substantial fees via post-dated cheques. If a cheque bounces, ERP lacks a 1-click 'Dishonour Cheque' action to reverse receipt and levy bank charges.

missing_features.feature: Parent Online Payment Gateway Integration (Razorpay / Billdesk)
missing_features.impact: Parents can view fees on mobile, but there is no integrated payment gateway webhook to clear dues digitally.

missing_features.feature: Automated SMS / WhatsApp Absentee Notification to Parents
missing_features.impact: Real schools are mandated to notify parents within 1 hour if a child is marked absent during morning roll call.
Secondary and senior secondary classes (9-12) often cut individual subject periods; daily morning-only attendance misses mid-day absenteeism.

missing_features.feature: Real-Time GPS Vehicle Tracking & Parent Live Bus Map
missing_features.impact: Parents demand real-time bus location and arrival estimates. Mobile app currently shows only assigned route and stop timings.

missing_features.feature: Driver License & Fitness Expiry Automated Alerts
missing_features.impact: Regulatory compliance requires alerting management 30 days before bus fitness, insurance, or driver license expires.

missing_features.feature: Hostel Medical Sickbay Log & Emergency Doctor Visit Register
missing_features.impact: Residential schools require tracking overnight illnesses, prescriptions, and infirmary bed stays.

missing_features.feature: Teacher Biometric Punch Machine Direct API Sync
missing_features.impact: Schools utilize ZKTeco/essl biometric devices; currently HR must manually record staff attendance or upload files.
